part1.tip: "The lady is typing on the laptop" (C) is a common trap — a laptop is visible, so it feels safe, but if the photo actually shows a hand-off of paper between people, typing is simply the wrong action regardless of how plausible the object is.
part1.tipVn: "The lady is typing on the laptop" (C) là bẫy phổ biến — laptop hiện diện trong ảnh nên cảm giác an toàn, nhưng nếu ảnh thực sự cho thấy việc trao giấy tờ giữa người với người, thì typing đơn giản là hành động sai dù vật thể có hợp lý đến đâu.
part1.tipTh: "The lady is typing on the laptop" (C) เป็นกับดักทั่วไป — แล็ปท็อปมองเห็นได้ ทำให้รู้สึกปลอดภัย แต่ถ้าภาพจริงๆ แสดงการส่งกระดาษระหว่างคน typing ก็เป็นเพียงหน้าที่ผิดไม่ว่าวัตถุจะสมเหตุสมผลแค่ไหน
part1.tipZh: "The lady is typing on the laptop"（C）是常見陷阱——筆電清晰可見，讓人感覺安全，但如果照片其實顯示的是人與人之間遞紙張，那麼無論這個物品多麼合理，typing 都只是錯誤的動作。
part1.tipFr: "The lady is typing on the laptop" (C) est un piège courant — un ordinateur portable est visible, ce qui semble sûr, mais si la photo montre en réalité un échange de papier entre personnes, taper est simplement la mauvaise action, peu importe la plausibilité de l'objet.
part1.tipKo: "The lady is typing on the laptop"(C)는 흔한 함정입니다 — 노트북이 보여서 안전하게 느껴지지만, 만약 사진이 실제로 사람들 사이에 서류를 건네는 모습을 보여준다면, 물건이 아무리 그럴듯해도 typing은 단순히 틀린 동작입니다.
part1.tipJa: "The lady is typing on the laptop"（C）はよくある罠です — ノートパソコンが見えるため安全に感じますが、写真が実際には人同士の書類の受け渡しを示している場合、その物がどれほどもっともらしくても、typing は単に間違った動作です。
part1.tipId: "The lady is typing on the laptop" (C) adalah jebakan umum — laptop terlihat, jadi terasa aman, tetapi jika foto sebenarnya menunjukkan penyerahan kertas antar orang, mengetik hanyalah tindakan yang salah, tak peduli seberapa masuk akal bendanya.
part1.tipEl: Το "the lady is typing on the laptop" (C) είναι μια συνηθισμένη παγίδα — ένα λάπτοπ είναι ορατό, οπότε νιώθει ασφαλές, αλλά αν η φωτογραφία δείχνει στην πραγματικότητα την παράδοση χαρτιού μεταξύ ανθρώπων, η πληκτρολόγηση είναι απλώς η λάθος ενέργεια, ανεξάρτητα από το πόσο εύλογο είναι το αντικείμενο.
part1.tipEs: "The lady is typing on the laptop" (C) es una trampa común — una laptop es visible, así que se siente segura, pero si la foto en realidad muestra un intercambio de papel entre personas, escribir es simplemente la acción equivocada sin importar cuán plausible sea el objeto.

part1.tipFr: "The waiter is talking to the man" (D) est tentant car une interaction serveur/client est plausible, mais si la femme (pas le serveur) est celle qui fait activement quelque chose de précis (commander), l'énoncé sur le serveur qui parle est une distraction du véritable sujet de l'action.

part1.tipEs: "The waiter is talking to the man" (D) es tentador porque una interacción camarero/cliente es plausible, pero si la mujer (no el camarero) es quien está haciendo activamente algo específico (ordenar comida), el enunciado sobre el camarero hablando distrae del verdadero sujeto de la acción.

part1.tip: "Occupied" (B) directly contradicts "unoccupied" (D) — this is a classic opposite-pair setup where reading the photo carefully for the presence or absence of people is the entire test, not any grammar or vocabulary nuance.
part1.tipVn: "Occupied" (B) trực tiếp trái ngược với "unoccupied" (D) — đây là mẫu cặp đối lập kinh điển, nơi việc đọc kỹ ảnh để xác định có hay không có người là toàn bộ bài kiểm tra, không phải sắc thái ngữ pháp hay từ vựng nào.
part1.tipTh: "Occupied" (B) ขัดแย้งโดยตรงกับ "unoccupied" (D) — นี่คือการตั้งค่าคู่ตรงข้ามคลาสสิกที่การอ่านภาพอย่างละเอียดเพื่อดูการมีอยู่หรือไม่มีอยู่ของคนคือการทดสอบทั้งหมด ไม่ใช่ความแตกต่างทางไวยากรณ์หรือคำศัพท์ใดๆ
part1.tipZh: "Occupied"（B）與 "unoccupied"（D）直接矛盾——這是經典的對立配對設置，仔細觀察照片中是否有人存在就是整個測驗的重點，而非任何文法或詞彙上的細微差別。
part1.tipFr: "Occupied" (B) contredit directement "unoccupied" (D) — c'est un schéma classique de paire opposée où lire attentivement la photo pour la présence ou l'absence de personnes est tout le test, pas une nuance de grammaire ou de vocabulaire.
part1.tipKo: "Occupied"(B)는 "unoccupied"(D)와 정반대입니다 — 이는 전형적인 반대쌍 설정으로, 사진을 주의 깊게 읽어 사람의 존재 유무를 파악하는 것이 시험의 전부이지, 문법이나 어휘의 뉘앙스가 아닙니다.
part1.tipJa: "Occupied"（B）は "unoccupied"（D）と直接矛盾します — これは典型的な対義語のペア設定であり、写真を注意深く読んで人がいるかいないかを見極めることが試験のすべてであり、文法や語彙のニュアンスではありません。
part1.tipId: "Occupied" (B) secara langsung bertentangan dengan "unoccupied" (D) — ini adalah pengaturan pasangan berlawanan klasik di mana membaca foto dengan cermat untuk keberadaan atau ketiadaan orang adalah keseluruhan ujiannya, bukan nuansa tata bahasa atau kosakata apa pun.

part1.tipZh: "Signing a contract"（A）和 "sharing business cards"（D）都是合理的商務會面動作，但 "shaking hands" 是更普遍可辨識、也更常被描繪的問候手勢——當畫面呈現的是更簡單的動作時，不要過度思考轉向聽起來更具體的動作。
part1.tipFr: "Signing a contract" (A) et "sharing business cards" (D) sont toutes deux des actions plausibles de réunion d'affaires, mais "shaking hands" est le geste de salutation le plus universellement reconnaissable et fréquemment représenté — ne surinterprétez pas vers une action au son plus spécifique quand quelque chose de plus simple est montré.
part1.tipKo: "Signing a contract"(A)와 "sharing business cards"(D)는 둘 다 그럴듯한 비즈니스 미팅 동작이지만, "shaking hands"가 더 보편적으로 알아볼 수 있고 흔히 묘사되는 인사 몸짓입니다 — 더 단순한 것이 보여질 때 더 구체적으로 들리는 동작으로 과대 해석하지 마세요.
part1.tipJa: "Signing a contract"（A）と "sharing business cards"（D）はどちらももっともらしいビジネスミーティングの動作ですが、"shaking hands" はより普遍的に認識でき、よく描かれる挨拶のジェスチャーです — よりシンプルなものが示されているときに、より具体的に聞こえる動作へ考えすぎないようにしましょう。
part1.tipId: "Signing a contract" (A) dan "sharing business cards" (D) sama-sama tindakan rapat bisnis yang masuk akal, tetapi "shaking hands" adalah gestur sapaan yang lebih universal dikenali dan lebih sering digambarkan — jangan terlalu memikirkan tindakan yang terdengar lebih spesifik ketika sesuatu yang lebih sederhana ditunjukkan.
part1.tipEl: Τόσο το "signing a contract" (A) όσο και το "sharing business cards" (D) είναι εύλογες ενέργειες επιχειρηματικής συνάντησης, αλλά το "shaking hands" είναι η πιο καθολικά αναγνωρίσιμη και συχνά απεικονιζόμενη χειρονομία χαιρετισμού — μην υπερ-σκέφτεστε προς μια πιο συγκεκριμένη ενέργεια όταν φαίνεται κάτι πιο απλό.
part1.tipEs: "Signing a contract" (A) y "sharing business cards" (D) son ambas acciones plausibles de reunión de negocios, pero "shaking hands" es el gesto de saludo más universalmente reconocible y frecuentemente representado — no sobreanalices hacia una acción que suena más específica cuando se muestra algo más simple.

[M:] I’ll be out of town for the next four days on business and when I get back I’ll be quite busy.

{W:} I see. (54) The board of directors would love to have you do the speech. They really liked it last time you delivered it.

[M:] (55) Thanks, but I’ll have to pass on it. I just have too much on my plate at the moment. If I had some more time to prepare, I would have considered it.

{W:} OK, I understand. I’ll let the board know. I hope you have a safe trip.

[M:] Thanks for your understanding, Debra.

{W:} Γεια σας, κύριε Morgan. Είμαι η Debra. Έχουμε ένα μικρό πρόβλημα. Το άτομο που επρόκειτο να κάνει την κεντρική ομιλία την επόμενη εβδομάδα είναι άρρωστο. Οπότε χρειαζόμαστε να βρούμε αντικαταστάτη. Θα μπορούσατε να το κάνετε εσείς;

[M:] Θα λείπω από την πόλη για επαγγελματικούς λόγους τις επόμενες τέσσερις ημέρες και όταν επιστρέψω θα είμαι αρκετά απασχολημένος.

{W:} Κατάλαβα. Το διοικητικό συμβούλιο θα ήθελε πολύ να κάνετε εσείς την ομιλία. Τους άρεσε πολύ την τελευταία φορά που την παρουσιάσατε.

[M:] Ευχαριστώ, αλλά θα πρέπει να το αρνηθώ αυτή τη φορά. Απλά έχω πάρα πολλά στο πιάτο μου αυτή τη στιγμή. Αν είχα λίγο περισσότερο χρόνο για προετοιμασία, θα το είχα εξετάσει.

{W:} Εντάξει, καταλαβαίνω. Θα ενημερώσω το συμβούλιο. Ελπίζω να έχετε ένα ασφαλές ταξίδι.

[M:] Ευχαριστώ για την κατανόησή σας, Debra.

Con tàu phía trước chúng ta có vẻ đang gặp một trục trặc nhỏ. Khi chúng tôi nhận được sự cho phép chính thức từ trung tâm điều khiển giao thông, chúng tôi sẽ tiếp tục di chuyển như bình thường. Rất tiếc, chúng ta sẽ đến muộn hơn một chút so với giờ đến theo lịch trình. Chúng tôi xin lỗi về sự bất tiện này. Xin vui lòng điều chỉnh kế hoạch của bạn cho phù hợp. Cảm ơn sự kiên nhẫn của các bạn. Chúng ta sẽ khởi hành trong thời gian ngắn nữa.

part5.tip: "Excited" (C) is the classic trap here because it's grammatically an adjective too, but it describes a person's feeling, while "opportunity" is a thing that causes excitement, not something that feels it — remember: things are "exciting", people are "excited".
part5.tipVn: "Excited" (C) là bẫy kinh điển ở đây vì cũng là tính từ đúng ngữ pháp, nhưng nó mô tả cảm xúc của một người, trong khi "opportunity" là vật gây ra sự hào hứng, không phải thứ cảm nhận nó — hãy nhớ: sự vật thì "exciting", con người thì "excited".
part5.tipTh: "Excited" (C) เป็นกับดักคลาสสิกที่นี่เพราะเป็นคำคุณศัพท์ทางไวยากรณ์ด้วย แต่มันอธิบายความรู้สึกของบุคคล ในขณะที่ "opportunity" เป็นสิ่งที่ทำให้เกิดความตื่นเต้น ไม่ใช่สิ่งที่รู้สึก — จำไว้ว่า: สิ่งของคือ "exciting" คนคือ "excited"
part5.tipZh: "Excited"（C）在這裡是經典陷阱，因為它文法上也是形容詞，但它描述的是人的感受，而 "opportunity" 是引發興奮的事物，而不是感受興奮的東西——請記住：事物是 "exciting"，人是 "excited"。

part5.tip: "Will import" (A) is tempting because it also expresses future meaning, but you can't stack two modal verbs ("must will") — after a modal like "must", only the bare infinitive or "be + past participle" (for passive) follows, never another modal.
part5.tipVn: "Will import" (A) hấp dẫn vì cũng diễn tả nghĩa tương lai, nhưng bạn không thể chồng hai động từ khiếm khuyết ("must will") — sau động từ khiếm khuyết như "must", chỉ động từ nguyên mẫu hoặc "be + quá khứ phân từ" (cho bị động) mới theo sau, không bao giờ là động từ khiếm khuyết khác.
part5.tipTh: "Will import" (A) น่าดึงดูดเพราะยังแสดงความหมายอนาคตด้วย แต่คุณไม่สามารถซ้อนกริยาช่วยสองตัว ("must will") ได้ — หลัง modal อย่าง "must" มีเพียงกริยานุ่นเดิมหรือ "be + past participle" (สำหรับ passive) เท่านั้นที่ตามมา ไม่เคยเป็น modal อีกตัว
part5.tipZh: "Will import"（A）很誘人，因為它也表達未來含義，但你不能疊加兩個情態動詞（"must will"）——在像 "must" 這樣的情態動詞之後，只能接原形動詞或 "be + 過去分詞"（表被動），絕不能再接另一個情態動詞。
part5.tipFr: "Will import" (A) est tentant car il exprime aussi un sens futur, mais vous ne pouvez pas empiler deux modaux ("must will") — après un modal comme "must", seul l'infinitif sans "to" ou "be + participe passé" (pour le passif) suit, jamais un autre modal.
part5.tipKo: "Will import"(A)는 미래의 의미도 나타내기 때문에 유혹적이지만, 두 개의 조동사("must will")를 겹쳐 쓸 수는 없습니다 — "must" 같은 조동사 뒤에는 동사 원형이나 (수동태를 위한) "be + 과거분사"만 올 수 있으며, 다른 조동사가 오는 법은 없습니다.
part5.tipJa: "Will import"（A）も未来の意味を表すため魅力的ですが、二つの助動詞（"must will"）を重ねることはできません — "must" のような助動詞の後には、動詞の原形または（受動態のための）「be + 過去分詞」だけが続き、別の助動詞は決して続きません。
part5.tipId: "Will import" (A) menggoda karena juga mengungkapkan makna masa depan, tetapi Anda tidak bisa menumpuk dua kata kerja modal ("must will") — setelah modal seperti "must", hanya bentuk dasar atau "be + past participle" (untuk pasif) yang mengikuti, tidak pernah modal lain.
part5.tipEl: Το "will import" (A) είναι δελεαστικό αφού εκφράζει επίσης μελλοντική σημασία, αλλά δεν μπορείτε να στοιβάξετε δύο τροπικά ρήματα ("must will") — μετά από ένα τροπικό όπως το "must", ακολουθεί μόνο το γυμνό απαρέμφατο ή "be + μετοχή παρελθόντα χρόνου" (για παθητική), ποτέ άλλο τροπικό.
part5.tipEs: "Will import" (A) es tentador porque también expresa sentido futuro, pero no puedes apilar dos verbos modales ("must will") — después de un modal como "must", solo sigue el infinitivo sin "to" o "be + participio pasado" (para pasiva), nunca otro modal.

part5.tip: All four choices are grammatically valid adverbs here, which is the real trap — this question can't be solved by grammar at all, only by meaning; "periodically" (about timing) is easy to pick by mistake when the sentence is actually about physical placement.

part5.tipKo: 네 가지 선택지 모두 문법적으로 유효한 부사여서, 그것이 진짜 함정입니다 — 이 문제는 문법으로는 전혀 풀 수 없고 오직 의미로만 풀 수 있습니다; 문장이 실제로 물리적 위치에 관한 것일 때 "periodically"(시기에 관한)를 실수로 고르기 쉽습니다.

part5.tipEs: Las cuatro opciones son gramaticalmente válidas como adverbios aquí, lo cual es la verdadera trampa — esta pregunta no puede resolverse en absoluto con gramática, solo con significado; "periodically" (sobre el momento) es fácil de elegir por error cuando la oración en realidad trata sobre la ubicación física.

part5.tipVn: "Responded" (B) hấp dẫn vì cũng liên quan đến việc trao đổi thông tin, nhưng "released to a third party" nghĩa cụ thể là thông tin được tiết lộ/cung cấp cho ai đó bên ngoài tổ chức — hãy khớp động từ với đúng hành động chia sẻ dữ liệu ra bên ngoài, không chỉ bất kỳ động từ liên quan đến thông tin nào.
part5.tipTh: "Responded" (B) ล่อใจเพราะยังเกี่ยวข้องกับการสื่อสารข้อมูลด้วย แต่ "released to a third party" หมายถึงข้อมูลที่ถูกเปิดเผย/ให้แก่ใครบางคนนอกองค์กรโดยเฉพาะ — จับคู่กริยากับการกระทำที่แม่นยำของการแบ่งปันข้อมูลภายนอก ไม่ใช่แค่กริยาที่เกี่ยวข้องกับข้อมูลใดๆ
part5.tipZh: "Responded"（B）很誘人，因為它也與溝通資訊有關，但 "released to a third party" 特指資訊被披露/提供給組織外部的某人——請將動詞與對外分享資料這個精確動作相配對，而不只是任何與資訊相關的動詞。
part5.tipFr: "Responded" (B) est tentant car il est aussi lié à la communication d'informations, mais "released to a third party" signifie spécifiquement que des informations ont été divulguées/données à quelqu'un en dehors de l'organisation — associez le verbe à l'action précise de partager des données à l'extérieur, pas juste n'importe quel verbe lié à l'information.
part5.tipKo: "Responded"(B)도 정보를 전달하는 것과 관련이 있어 유혹적이지만, "released to a third party"는 정보가 조직 외부의 누군가에게 특별히 공개/제공되었다는 것을 의미합니다 — 정보와 관련된 아무 동사가 아니라 외부로 데이터를 공유하는 정확한 동작에 동사를 맞추세요.
part5.tipJa: "Responded"（B）も情報伝達に関連するため魅力的ですが、"released to a third party" は具体的に情報が組織外の誰かに開示・提供されたことを意味します — 情報に関連する動詞なら何でもよいのではなく、外部にデータを共有するという正確な動作に動詞を合わせましょう。
part5.tipId: "Responded" (B) menggoda karena juga berkaitan dengan komunikasi informasi, tetapi "released to a third party" secara khusus berarti informasi diungkapkan/diberikan kepada seseorang di luar organisasi — cocokkan kata kerja dengan tindakan tepat berbagi data secara eksternal, bukan hanya kata kerja apa pun yang terkait informasi.
part5.tipEl: Το "responded" (B) είναι δελεαστικό αφού σχετίζεται επίσης με την επικοινωνία πληροφοριών, αλλά το "released to a third party" σημαίνει συγκεκριμένα ότι πληροφορίες αποκαλύφθηκαν/δόθηκαν σε κάποιον εκτός του οργανισμού — ταιριάξτε το ρήμα με την ακριβή ενέργεια εξωτερικής κοινοποίησης δεδομένων, όχι απλώς οποιοδήποτε ρήμα σχετικό με πληροφορίες.
part5.tipEs: "Responded" (B) es tentador porque también se relaciona con la comunicación de información, pero "released to a third party" significa específicamente que la información fue divulgada/entregada a alguien fuera de la organización — haz coincidir el verbo con la acción precisa de compartir datos externamente, no solo cualquier verbo relacionado con información.

part5.tipVn: "His" (A, tính từ sở hữu) là lựa chọn sai phổ biến vì cũng liên quan đến "he", nhưng cụm từ cần đại từ phản thân để nhấn mạnh (nghĩa "anh ấy có thể tự làm một mình") — cách dùng phản thân nhấn mạnh là mẫu ngữ pháp khác biệt so với sở hữu đơn thuần.
part5.tipTh: "His" (A, คำคุณศัพท์แสดงความเป็นเจ้าของ) เป็นตัวเลือกผิดที่พบบ่อยเพราะยังเกี่ยวข้องกับ "he" แต่วลีต้องการสรรพนามสะท้อนเพื่อเน้นย้ำ (หมายถึง "เขาสามารถทำได้เพียงลำพัง") — การใช้สรรพนามสะท้อนเพื่อเน้นเป็นรูปแบบไวยากรณ์ที่แตกต่างจากการแสดงความเป็นเจ้าของธรรมดา
part5.tipZh: "His"（A，所有格形容詞）是常見的錯誤選項，因為它也和 "he" 有關，但這個片語需要一個反身代名詞來表示強調（意思是「他可以獨自完成」）——強調用的反身代名詞用法，是與單純的所有格截然不同的文法模式。
part5.tipFr: "His" (A, adjectif possessif) est un choix erroné courant car il est aussi lié à "he", mais la phrase nécessite un pronom réfléchi pour l'emphase (signifiant "il peut le faire seul/par lui-même") — l'usage réfléchi emphatique est un schéma grammatical distinct de la simple possession.
part5.tipKo: "His"(A, 소유형용사)는 "he"와도 관련이 있어 흔한 오답이지만, 이 구문은 강조를 위한 재귀대명사가 필요합니다("그는 혼자서/스스로 할 수 있다"라는 뜻) — 강조를 위한 재귀 용법은 단순 소유와는 별개의 문법 패턴입니다.
part5.tipJa: "His"（A、所有格形容詞）は "he" とも関連するためよくある誤答ですが、この句は強調のための再帰代名詞を必要とします（「彼は一人で／自分自身でできる」という意味）— 強調のための再帰用法は、単なる所有とは異なる文法パターンです。
part5.tipId: "His" (A, kata sifat posesif) adalah pilihan salah yang umum karena juga berkaitan dengan "he", tetapi frasa itu membutuhkan kata ganti refleksif untuk penekanan (berarti "dia bisa melakukannya sendiri") — penggunaan refleksif yang menekankan adalah pola gramatikal yang berbeda dari kepemilikan sederhana.
part5.tipEl: Το "his" (A, κτητικό επίθετο) είναι μια συχνή λανθασμένη επιλογή επειδή σχετίζεται επίσης με το "he", αλλά η φράση χρειάζεται μια αναφορική αντωνυμία για έμφαση (που σημαίνει "μπορεί να το κάνει μόνος του") — η εμφατική αναφορική χρήση είναι ένα διαφορετικό γραμματικό μοτίβο από την απλή κτήση.
part5.tipEs: "His" (A, adjetivo posesivo) es una elección incorrecta común porque también se relaciona con "he", pero la frase necesita un pronombre reflexivo para dar énfasis (que significa "él puede hacerlo solo/por sí mismo") — el uso reflexivo enfático es un patrón gramatical distinto de la simple posesión.

part5.tip: "Who" (D) is the classic trap for "whose" — both are relative pronouns referring to people, but "who" replaces a subject/object (a person), while "whose" specifically shows possession ("the agent's name") — check whether the relative clause needs a person or something that person owns.
part5.tipVn: "Who" (D) là bẫy kinh điển cho "whose" — cả hai đều là đại từ quan hệ chỉ người, nhưng "who" thay thế chủ ngữ/tân ngữ (một người), còn "whose" chỉ cụ thể sự sở hữu ("tên của người đại lý") — hãy kiểm tra xem mệnh đề quan hệ cần một người hay thứ mà người đó sở hữu.
part5.tipTh: "Who" (D) เป็นกับดักคลาสสิกสำหรับ "whose" — ทั้งสองเป็นสรรพนามสัมพันธ์ที่อ้างถึงคน แต่ "who" แทนที่ประธาน/กรรม (บุคคล) ในขณะที่ "whose" แสดงความเป็นเจ้าของโดยเฉพาะ ("ชื่อของตัวแทน") — ตรวจสอบว่าอนุประโยคสัมพันธ์ต้องการบุคคลหรือสิ่งที่บุคคลนั้นเป็นเจ้าของ
part5.tipZh: "Who"（D）是 "whose" 的經典陷阱——兩者都是指人的關係代名詞，但 "who" 替代主詞/受詞（一個人），而 "whose" 特指所有格（「代理人的名字」）——請檢查關係子句需要的是一個人，還是那個人所擁有的東西。
part5.tipFr: "Who" (D) est le piège classique pour "whose" — les deux sont des pronoms relatifs référant à des personnes, mais "who" remplace un sujet/objet (une personne), tandis que "whose" montre spécifiquement la possession ("le nom de l'agent") — vérifiez si la proposition relative a besoin d'une personne ou de quelque chose que cette personne possède.
part5.tipKo: "Who"(D)는 "whose"에 대한 전형적인 함정입니다 — 둘 다 사람을 가리키는 관계대명사이지만, "who"는 주어/목적어(사람)를 대체하고, "whose"는 구체적으로 소유를 나타냅니다("대리인의 이름") — 관계절이 사람을 필요로 하는지, 그 사람이 소유한 것을 필요로 하는지 확인하세요.
part5.tipJa: "Who"（D）は "whose" に対する典型的な罠です — どちらも人を指す関係代名詞ですが、"who" は主語・目的語（人）を置き換え、"whose" は特に所有を示します（「代理人の名前」）— 関係詞節が人を必要としているのか、その人が所有するものを必要としているのかを確認しましょう。
part5.tipId: "Who" (D) adalah jebakan klasik untuk "whose" — keduanya adalah kata ganti relatif yang merujuk pada orang, tetapi "who" menggantikan subjek/objek (orang), sedangkan "whose" secara khusus menunjukkan kepemilikan ("nama agen itu") — periksa apakah klausa relatif membutuhkan orang atau sesuatu yang dimiliki orang itu.
part5.tipEl: Το "who" (D) είναι η κλασική παγίδα για το "whose" — και τα δύο είναι αναφορικές αντωνυμίες που αναφέρονται σε ανθρώπους, αλλά το "who" αντικαθιστά ένα υποκείμενο/αντικείμενο (ένα άτομο), ενώ το "whose" δείχνει συγκεκριμένα κτήση ("το όνομα του πράκτορα") — ελέγξτε αν η αναφορική πρόταση χρειάζεται ένα άτομο ή κάτι που κατέχει αυτό το άτομο.
part5.tipEs: "Who" (D) es la trampa clásica para "whose" — ambos son pronombres relativos que se refieren a personas, pero "who" reemplaza a un sujeto/objeto (una persona), mientras que "whose" muestra específicamente posesión ("el nombre del agente") — verifica si la cláusula relativa necesita una persona o algo que esa persona posee.

part5.tipVn: Động từ (B) hấp dẫn ngay sau "becomes", nhưng "becomes" là động từ liên kết phải theo sau bởi tính từ mô tả trạng thái mới của chủ ngữ, không phải một hành động khác — "final" là đáp án duy nhất đúng ngữ pháp ở vị trí này.

part5.tipZh: 動詞（B）在 "becomes" 之後很誘人，但 "becomes" 是連綴動詞，後面必須接形容詞來描述主詞的新狀態，而不是另一個動作——"final" 是此位置唯一在文法上有效的選項。
part5.tipFr: Un verbe (B) est tentant juste après "becomes", mais "becomes" est un verbe de liaison qui doit être suivi d'un adjectif décrivant le nouvel état du sujet, pas une autre action — "final" est la seule option grammaticalement valide à cette position.
part5.tipKo: 동사(B)는 "becomes" 바로 뒤에서 유혹적이지만, "becomes"는 연결동사로 주어의 새로운 상태를 설명하는 형용사가 뒤따라야 하며, 다른 동작이 오면 안 됩니다 — "final"이 이 위치에서 문법적으로 유일하게 유효한 선택지입니다.
part5.tipJa: 動詞（B）は "becomes" のすぐ後で魅力的ですが、"becomes" は連結動詞であり、後には主語の新しい状態を説明する形容詞が続かなければならず、別の動作ではありません — "final" がこの位置で文法的に唯一有効な選択肢です。
part5.tipId: Kata kerja (B) menggoda tepat setelah "becomes", tetapi "becomes" adalah kata kerja penghubung yang harus diikuti oleh kata sifat yang menggambarkan keadaan baru subjek, bukan tindakan lain — "final" adalah satu-satunya pilihan yang valid secara gramatikal di posisi ini.
part5.tipEl: Ένα ρήμα (B) είναι δελεαστικό ακριβώς μετά το "becomes", αλλά το "becomes" είναι συνδετικό ρήμα που πρέπει να ακολουθείται από επίθετο που περιγράφει τη νέα κατάσταση του υποκειμένου, όχι άλλη ενέργεια — το "final" είναι η μόνη γραμματικά έγκυρη επιλογή σε αυτή τη θέση.

part5.tip: "Oversee" (B) is tempting because it's also a workplace-related verb about managing something, but "cooperate with each other" is a specific fixed phrase meaning to work together as equals — "oversee" implies a hierarchy that doesn't match the mutual, equal relationship the sentence describes.
part5.tipVn: "Oversee" (B) hấp dẫn vì cũng là động từ liên quan đến công việc về việc quản lý điều gì đó, nhưng "cooperate with each other" là cụm cố định cụ thể nghĩa làm việc cùng nhau một cách bình đẳng — "oversee" ngụ ý một hệ thống phân cấp không khớp với mối quan hệ tương hỗ, bình đẳng mà câu mô tả.
part5.tipTh: "Oversee" (B) ล่อใจเพราะยังเป็นกริยาเกี่ยวกับที่ทำงานเรื่องการจัดการบางสิ่งด้วย แต่ "cooperate with each other" เป็นวลีคงที่เฉพาะหมายถึงการทำงานร่วมกันอย่างเท่าเทียม — "oversee" ตัวบ่งบอกลำดับชั้นที่ไม่ตรงกับความสัมพันธ์ที่เท่าเทียมกันร่วมกันที่ประโยคอธิบาย
part5.tipZh: "Oversee"（B）很誘人，因為它也是與管理某事相關的職場動詞，但 "cooperate with each other" 是特指以平等身分共同合作的固定片語——"oversee" 暗示一種階層關係，這與句子所描述的相互、平等關係不符。
part5.tipFr: "Oversee" (B) est tentant car c'est aussi un verbe lié au travail concernant la gestion de quelque chose, mais "cooperate with each other" est une expression fixe spécifique signifiant travailler ensemble en égaux — "oversee" implique une hiérarchie qui ne correspond pas à la relation mutuelle et égale décrite par la phrase.
part5.tipKo: "Oversee"(B)도 무언가를 관리하는 것에 관한 직장 관련 동사여서 유혹적이지만, "cooperate with each other"는 대등하게 함께 일한다는 특정 고정 표현입니다 — "oversee"는 문장이 설명하는 상호적이고 평등한 관계와 맞지 않는 위계를 암시합니다.
part5.tipJa: "Oversee"（B）も何かを管理することに関する職場関連の動詞であるため魅力的ですが、"cooperate with each other" は対等に一緒に働くことを意味する特定の固定表現です — "oversee" は、文が説明する相互的で対等な関係に合わない階層を暗示します。
part5.tipId: "Oversee" (B) menggoda karena juga merupakan kata kerja terkait tempat kerja tentang mengelola sesuatu, tetapi "cooperate with each other" adalah frasa tetap spesifik yang berarti bekerja sama sebagai setara — "oversee" menyiratkan hierarki yang tidak cocok dengan hubungan yang setara dan saling menguntungkan yang digambarkan kalimat itu.
part5.tipEl: Το "oversee" (B) είναι δελεαστικό αφού είναι επίσης ρήμα σχετικό με τον χώρο εργασίας για τη διαχείριση κάποιου πράγματος, αλλά το "cooperate with each other" είναι μια συγκεκριμένη σταθερή φράση που σημαίνει να δουλεύεις μαζί ως ίσος — το "oversee" υπονοεί μια ιεραρχία που δεν ταιριάζει με την αμοιβαία, ισότιμη σχέση που περιγράφει η πρόταση.
part5.tipEs: "Oversee" (B) es tentador porque también es un verbo relacionado con el trabajo sobre gestionar algo, pero "cooperate with each other" es una frase fija específica que significa trabajar juntos como iguales — "oversee" implica una jerarquía que no coincide con la relación mutua e igualitaria que describe la oración.

part5.hint: - Subject 'pain' is relieved (passive, does not alleviate itself) -> not C, D (active forms) -> and the sentence talks about a future prediction from a doctor -> not A (simple past) -> choose B (will be alleviated).
part5.hintVn:
- Chủ ngữ 'pain' (cơn đau) là vật được làm giảm bớt (bị động, không tự nó làm giảm) -> loại C, D (thể chủ động) -> câu nói về dự đoán trong tương lai của bác sĩ -> loại A (quá khứ đơn) -> chọn B (will be alleviated: sẽ được giảm bớt).

questions.question: 130. According to the physician, Ms. Oliver's pain ------ within two hours of taking the medication.

part5.hintTh:

part5.hintZh:
- 主语'pain'（疼痛）是被减轻的对象（被动，而非自己主动减轻）-> 排除C、D（主动语态）-> 句子讲的是医生对未来的预测 -> 排除A（一般过去时）-> 选B（will be alleviated：将会被缓解）

- Alleviate (v): 缓解（疼痛）
part5.hintFr:
- Le sujet 'pain' (douleur) est ce qui est soulagé (passif, ne se soulage pas lui-même) -> exclut C, D (voix active) -> la phrase parle d'une prédiction future du médecin -> exclut A (passé simple) -> choisir B (will be alleviated : sera soulagée)

- Alleviate (v) : soulager (la douleur)
part5.hintKo:
- 주어 'pain'(통증)은 완화되는 대상임(수동태, 스스로 완화하는 것이 아님) -> C, D(능동태) 제외 -> 문장은 의사의 미래 예측에 대해 이야기함 -> A(단순과거) 제외 -> B(will be alleviated: 완화될 것이다) 선택

- Alleviate (v): 완화하다(통증을)
part5.hintJa:
- 主語'pain'（痛み）は緩和される対象である（受動態、自ら緩和するのではない）-> C、D（能動態）を除外 -> 文は医師の将来の予測について述べている -> A（過去形）を除外 -> B（will be alleviated：緩和されるだろう）を選択

- Alleviate (v): 緩和する（痛みを）
part5.hintId:
- Subjek 'pain' (rasa sakit) adalah objek yang diredakan (pasif, bukan meredakan sendiri) -> mengesampingkan C, D (bentuk aktif) -> kalimat membahas prediksi masa depan dokter -> mengesampingkan A (bentuk lampau sederhana) -> pilih B (will be alleviated: akan diredakan)

- Alleviate (v): meredakan (rasa sakit)
part5.hintEl:
- Το υποκείμενο 'pain' (πόνος) είναι αυτό που ανακουφίζεται (παθητική φωνή, δεν ανακουφίζεται μόνο του) -> αποκλείει τα C, D (ενεργητική φωνή) -> η πρόταση αφορά μια μελλοντική πρόβλεψη του γιατρού -> αποκλείει το A (απλός παρελθοντικός) -> επιλογή B (will be alleviated: θα ανακουφιστεί)

- Alleviate (v): ανακουφίζω (τον πόνο)
part5.hintEs:
- El sujeto 'pain' (dolor) es lo que se alivia (pasivo, no se alivia solo) -> descarta C, D (voz activa) -> la oración habla de una predicción futura del médico -> descarta A (pasado simple) -> elegir B (will be alleviated: será aliviado)

- Alleviate (v): aliviar (el dolor)
part5.tip: "Alleviated" alone in an active form (C, D) would wrongly suggest the pain is doing the relieving itself — pain is always the receiver of relief (passive), and since a doctor is predicting a future outcome, only the future passive "will be alleviated" fits both the voice and the tense needed.
part5.tipVn: "Alleviated" đơn lẻ ở dạng chủ động (C, D) sẽ sai lầm khi ngụ ý rằng cơn đau tự làm giảm chính nó — cơn đau luôn là đối tượng nhận sự giảm nhẹ (bị động), và vì bác sĩ đang dự đoán kết quả tương lai, chỉ có bị động tương lai "will be alleviated" mới khớp cả về thể lẫn thì cần thiết.
part5.tipTh: "Alleviated" เพียงลำพังในรูปแบบ active (C, D) จะบ่งบอกผิดว่าความเจ็บปวดกำลังบรรเทาตัวเอง — ความเจ็บปวดเป็นผู้รับการบรรเทาเสมอ (passive) และเนื่องจากแพทย์กำลังทำนายผลลัพธ์ในอนาคต มีเพียง passive อนาคต "will be alleviated" เท่านั้นที่ตรงทั้งเสียงและกาลที่ต้องการ
part5.tipZh: "Alleviated" 單獨以主動形式（C、D）出現，會錯誤地暗示疼痛正在自我緩解——疼痛永遠是被緩解的一方（被動），而且由於醫生正在預測未來的結果，只有未來被動式 "will be alleviated" 才同時符合所需的語態和時態。
part5.tipFr: "Alleviated" seul à la forme active (C, D) suggérerait à tort que la douleur se soulage elle-même — la douleur est toujours celle qui reçoit le soulagement (passif), et comme un médecin prédit un résultat futur, seul le passif futur "will be alleviated" correspond à la fois à la voix et au temps nécessaires.
part5.tipKo: 능동형(C, D)의 "Alleviated" 단독으로는 통증이 스스로 완화된다고 잘못 암시할 것입니다 — 통증은 항상 완화의 대상(수동)이며, 의사가 미래의 결과를 예측하고 있으므로 미래 수동형 "will be alleviated"만이 필요한 태와 시제 모두에 맞습니다.
part5.tipJa: 能動形（C、D）だけの "Alleviated" は、痛みが自分自身を和らげているかのように誤って示唆してしまいます — 痛みは常に緩和を受ける側（受動態）であり、医師が将来の結果を予測しているため、必要な態と時制の両方に合うのは未来受動態の "will be alleviated" だけです。
part5.tipId: "Alleviated" sendiri dalam bentuk aktif (C, D) akan secara keliru menyiratkan bahwa rasa sakit itu meredakan dirinya sendiri — rasa sakit selalu menjadi penerima peredaan (pasif), dan karena seorang dokter memprediksi hasil di masa depan, hanya bentuk pasif masa depan "will be alleviated" yang cocok baik dari segi bentuk maupun waktu yang dibutuhkan.
part5.tipEl: Το "alleviated" μόνο σε ενεργητική μορφή (C, D) θα υποδήλωνε λανθασμένα ότι ο πόνος ανακουφίζεται μόνος του — ο πόνος είναι πάντα ο δέκτης της ανακούφισης (παθητική φωνή), και εφόσον ένας γιατρός προβλέπει ένα μελλοντικό αποτέλεσμα, μόνο η μελλοντική παθητική "will be alleviated" ταιριάζει τόσο με τη φωνή όσο και με τον χρόνο που χρειάζεται.
part5.tipEs: "Alleviated" solo en forma activa (C, D) sugeriría erróneamente que el dolor se alivia a sí mismo — el dolor siempre es quien recibe el alivio (pasiva), y como un médico está prediciendo un resultado futuro, solo la pasiva futura "will be alleviated" coincide tanto con la voz como con el tiempo necesarios.

part6.description:
From: Vice President Jordan Smith
To: K Group Employees
Subject: Company Renovations
Date: February 26

To all employees,
This weekend the renovations to our second-floor offices ---(135)---. We ask that you take home all important documents and file away any loose materials on your desks. All electronic devices should be turned off and unplugged. ---(136)---, all cabinets and drawers should be locked.
The renovations will take approximately 5 days. ---(137)---. If you have any meetings scheduled with clients next week, please schedule to meet them outside the company premises due to the noise. We apologize for the inconvenience but we ask for your ---(138)---. Thank you.
part6.hint:
135 - will begin
Future tense: 'has began' is not a valid verb form; renovations start this coming weekend -> future simple

136. Furthermore
Need a conjunction/transition adding another instruction (not cause-result)

137 - During this time, your temporary workspace will be the first-floor conference room.
Leads into the next sentence about meeting clients outside the office

138. cooperation
Fixed phrase: 'ask for your cooperation'
part6.hintVn:
Từ: Phó Chủ tịch Jordan Smith
Đến: Nhân viên Tập đoàn K
Chủ đề: Cải tạo công ty
Ngày: 26 tháng 2

Kính gửi toàn thể nhân viên,
Cuối tuần này, việc cải tạo các văn phòng tầng hai của chúng ta sẽ bắt đầu. Chúng tôi đề nghị các bạn mang về nhà tất cả tài liệu quan trọng và cất gọn mọi giấy tờ rời trên bàn làm việc. Tất cả thiết bị điện tử nên được tắt và rút phích cắm. Hơn nữa, tất cả tủ và ngăn kéo nên được khóa lại.
Việc cải tạo sẽ mất khoảng 5 ngày. Trong thời gian này, nơi làm việc tạm thời của các bạn sẽ là phòng họp ở tầng một. Nếu bạn có bất kỳ cuộc họp nào đã lên lịch với khách hàng vào tuần tới, vui lòng sắp xếp gặp họ bên ngoài trụ sở công ty do tiếng ồn. Chúng tôi xin lỗi vì sự bất tiện này nhưng mong nhận được sự hợp tác của các bạn. Xin cảm ơn.
135 - will begin
This weekend the renovations to our second-floor offices will begin.
Cuối tuần này, việc cải tạo các văn phòng tầng hai của chúng ta sẽ bắt đầu.
'has began' không phải là dạng đúng của động từ; việc cải tạo bắt đầu vào cuối tuần sắp tới -> dùng thì tương lai đơn
Loại A (sai dạng động từ), C (thiếu trợ động từ), D (thiếu trợ động từ 'has')

136. Furthermore
..., all cabinets and drawers should be locked.
Hơn nữa, tất cả tủ và ngăn kéo nên được khóa lại.
Cần liên từ bổ sung thêm 1 yêu cầu nữa (không phải quan hệ nguyên nhân - kết quả)
Loại B, D (chỉ kết quả), C (Because - cần theo sau là 1 mệnh đề, không dùng đứng đầu câu kèm dấu phẩy như vậy)

137 - During this time, your temporary workspace will be the first-floor conference room.
Trong thời gian này, nơi làm việc tạm thời của các bạn sẽ là phòng họp ở tầng một.
Phù hợp mạch văn: dẫn vào câu tiếp theo nói về việc gặp khách hàng bên ngoài công ty

138. cooperation
...we ask for your cooperation.
...chúng tôi mong nhận được sự hợp tác của các bạn.
Cụm từ cố định: ask for one's cooperation (mong nhận được sự hợp tác)

- Renovation (n): sự cải tạo, tu sửa
- Premises (n): khuôn viên, trụ sở

options: If it takes longer, we will notify you.
All business will be suspended until the renovations end.
key:During this time, your temporary workspace will be the first-floor conference room.
Your office space will look new and improved after the renovations.

part6.hintTh:
จาก: รองประธาน Jordan Smith
ถึง: พนักงานบริษัท K
เรื่อง: การปรับปรุงบริษัท
วันที่: 26 กุมภาพันธ์

เรียนพนักงานทุกท่าน
สุดสัปดาห์นี้ การปรับปรุงสำนักงานชั้นสองของเราจะเริ่มขึ้น เราขอให้ทุกท่านนำเอกสารสำคัญทั้งหมดกลับบ้านและจัดเก็บกระดาษที่วางอยู่บนโต๊ะทำงานให้เรียบร้อย อุปกรณ์อิเล็กทรอนิกส์ทั้งหมดควรถูกปิดและถอดปลั๊ก นอกจากนี้ ตู้และลิ้นชักทั้งหมดควรถูกล็อค
การปรับปรุงจะใช้เวลาประมาณ 5 วัน ในช่วงเวลานี้ พื้นที่ทำงานชั่วคราวของท่านจะเป็นห้องประชุมที่ชั้นหนึ่ง หากท่านมีนัดหมายกับลูกค้าในสัปดาห์หน้า กรุณาจัดให้พบกันนอกสถานที่บริษัทเนื่องจากเสียงรบกวน เราขออภัยในความไม่สะดวกนี้แต่หวังว่าจะได้รับความร่วมมือจากท่าน ขอบคุณค่ะ
135 - will begin
This weekend the renovations to our second-floor offices will begin.
'has began' ไม่ใช่รูปกริยาที่ถูกต้อง; การปรับปรุงจะเริ่มในสุดสัปดาห์ที่จะถึง -> ใช้ future simple tense
ตัดตัวเลือก A (รูปกริยาผิด), C (ขาด auxiliary verb), D (ขาด auxiliary verb 'has')

136. Furthermore
..., all cabinets and drawers should be locked.
ต้องใช้คำเชื่อมที่เพิ่มเติมข้อกำหนดอีกอย่าง (ไม่ใช่ความสัมพันธ์เหตุ-ผล)
ตัดตัวเลือก B, D (แสดงผลลัพธ์), C (Because - ต้องตามด้วยประโยคย่อย ไม่ใช้ขึ้นต้นประโยคพร้อมจุลภาคแบบนี้)

137 - During this time, your temporary workspace will be the first-floor conference room.
เหมาะสมกับเนื้อหา: นำไปสู่ประโยคถัดไปที่พูดถึงการพบลูกค้านอกบริษัท

138. cooperation
...we ask for your cooperation.

part7.description:
More Buses During the Holidays

November 28- - [1] - Although the holiday season signals a nice week-long vacation for many, bus drivers will work longer hours and straight into the holidays to accommodate the many tourists that are flooding the city this lime of year and the shoppers that are busy buying those last-minute gifts, - [2] - The city announced new bus schedules for the next few weeks which included some routes where the buses would run all day and all night. While most buses stop running by 1:00 A.M.. some parts of downtown will see buses running ail night. The Bingham shopping district will also see buses running until 3:00 A.M. "This is when we have the most tourists and out-of-town folks coming to visit," explained Mayor Bill Nate, "We felt it was important to provide the necessary services during this time," - [3] -
When the bus drivers' union leader, Nathan Reiner, was asked about the new schedules he responded, "We worked out a payment that is agreeable on both sides and have enough drivers that can work in shifts so that there is no danger of overworking or exhaustion. Many of us will still get some time off during the holidays with our families." - [4] -

part7.description:
J&R International Group Discussion
Sunny Rhee[5:37]Is anyone unable to make it to Friday's office party?
Kevin King[5:38]I can be there for the first hour, but I need to leave early for a family get together.
Patrick Stone[5:39]I have a business trip to Hong Kong the next day so I'm going to take a pass this year.
Sunny Rhee[5:42]Is that everyone then? Ijust want to make sure that we have enough snacks. Eva, did you contact the caterers yet?
Eva Sanderson[5:43]I called a couple of different places, but only Four-Leaf Catering offers vegan options.
Sunny Rhee[5:44]Why don't we give them a try then? I think a couple of people here are vegans.
Holly Johnson[5:45]I don't normally like to advertise my eating preferences, but I would love to have vegan options this time.
Eva Sanderson[5:46]I agree. I think it would make everything more interesting. I'm thinking of trying to go vegan myself and this would be a good first step for me.
Holly Johnson[5:47]Well, it's not easy but I'll be there to support you.
Eva Sanderson[5:47]Thanks. I'll order our platters from the caterers then.
Angelo Smith[5:48]But make sure there are some meat dishes for us meat-lovers.
Eva Sanderson[5:49]Of course. I e-mailed everyone our tentative menu and most of you seemed to like the choices.
Sunny Rhee[5:50]Don't forget to e-mail the caterers about the security clearance they'll need to enter the building.
Eva Sanderson[5:51]I'll work on that now.

part7.description:
April 2 - Repairs will begin next Friday on the historic Marion Hall in downtown Marion. In its heyday, Marion Hall was a popular downtown destination for residents to dance, enjoy live music, and watch movies. However, it has lost its popularity gradually since the multiplex building was completed on Henson Street 4 years ago.

After all of the necessary repairs are made on Marion Hall, city officials will strive to invite various performers including famous theater companies, musicians, comedians, and speakers to the newly renovated theater. "We hope Marion Hall can serve as a new center for culture here in Marion," said Marion City Mayor Greg Fields.

The revitalization of Marion Hall is part of a larger project to enhance the public facilities in Marion. On April 29, the Marion Children's Park, which features a baseball field as well as several playgrounds, is scheduled to have its grand reopening.

part7.description: As I'm sure you're aware, this week we must decide if we want to continue working with CC Wheel Delivery. After yesterday's meeting, it's clear that they are being sued for the accident that happened last week. -[1]- We all agreed that the whole company shouldn't be liable for the mistakes of a few careless workers. But, that was a conversation we had before we had really thought about the ramifications of our decision. -[2]- Unfortunately, the situation is escalating and there is about to be a lot of bad press. -[3]- It's true that many of them are our friends. But, we must protect our company, We can't handle anything that could alter our sales, For the last four months, we've been operating with a very thin margin for error. If our sales drop even the slightest, it could be detrimental. So, I'm suggesting that, as a means of protecting ourselves from any negative backlash, we cut our ties with CC Wheel Delivery. Maybe later, if they're able to rehabilitate their name, we'll work with them again, -[4]- I propose we vote one more time on whether or not to work with them.

part7.description:
September 21—What is the secret to delicious home-cooked meals? Kimberly Lee, host of the My Home Cooking television show and owner of her own restaurant chain, seems to know all the secrets. Her show has been on the air for over two years, and now she has a devoted group of followers around the country. When she sat down for an interview with us, she said that fresh vegetables and local produce are the key to cooking healthy and tasty food.

Ms. Lee is scheduled to publish her very first cookbook near the end of the month. The book is entitled Kimberly Lee's My Home Cooking, and it provides easy-to- follow recipes that can be made in less than 30 minutes. Over 40,000 copies have already been pre-ordered so far.

Ms. Lee says that the final page of the book will include a detachable fan club membership form. Those who fill the form out and send it in to the provided address will receive a monthly newsletter and exclusive recipes available only to those in the fan club. Fan club members will also receive a password that allows access to a fan club website.
To: Kimberly Lee <kimberlylee@kimberlylee.com>
From: Suzie Sanders <suziesanderrss@kimberlylee.com>
Date: October 12
Subject: Update

Dear Ms. Lee,

Great news! I'm happy to report that not only has your book been selling well, but the number of new members joining the fan cilub has been increasing drastically since it was published. I'm certain that the article in the newspaper helped generate considerable publicity for your book.

Also, we have received a lot of feedback from new members expressing a desire for more recipes for ·cakes, cookies, and candies to be featured in next month's newsletter. I think it would be a good idea to meet their needs this time.

Sincerely,

Suzie Sanders
Publlicity Coordinator

From: Stacey Watkins <staceywatkins@titus.com>
To: Ann Rose <annrose@puttkincomp.com>
Subject: Conference of Bank Managers
Date: February 12

Dear Ms. Rose,

You recenttlly contacted us about using our conference center again this year to host your Annual Conference of Bank Managers. This year we have updated our conference room with new projectors and more comfortable seating. We will be providing shuttle busses from the airport and a premium buffet in the dining hall as well as an Internet cafe where guests can use computers or print documents at no cost. For your convenience, we will also be providing usefful supplies such as flip charts, 10-foot whitteboards, and projector screens.

Once you decide on a date, we ask that you please make a down payment of $1,0o0o0o after we see if it is available. The remaining balance should be paid upon your arrival. Also, we ask that as the organizer of the event, you arrive at the conference center a day before the conference begins.. This way, any unforeseen circumstances can be taken care of beforehand.

We appreciate your business with the Titus Conference Center again. We are looking forward to providing you with the best service possible.

Stacey Watkins,
Director
From: Ann Rose <annrose@puttkincomp.com>
To: Stacey Watkins <staceywattkins@titus.com>
Subject: RE: Conference of Bank Managers
Date: February 16

Dear Mr. Watkins,

I am also pleased to be working with you again this year. We would like to reserve your conference space for the weekend of August 15 to 16. Additionally, the down payment will be handled by our financial department. I will have one of the employees contact you soon.

There is one thing that Iwould like to tell you. Actually, last year, some of our attendees were disappointed because the dining hall didn't offer a variety of vegetarian options. I hope this inconvenience will be dealt with in advance this year.

Thank you,

Ann Rose
Organizer, Annual Conference of Bank Managers

To: John Masterson <jmasterson@mastersttrokeindustries..com>
From: Carl Ennens <cennens@gmail.com>
Date: December 30
Subject: Internship

Dear Mr. Masterson,

My name is Carl Ennens and I am entering my final year at Evergreen State College. I am majoring in industrial engineering here, and my liquid dynamics professor, Dr. Alcobar, recommended Master Stroke Industries as a possible internship opportunity. Your company is recognized as a leader in flow research. If you would be willing to accept an intern for the coming spring semester, I could give you up to 15 hours per week of work, provided that you are able to write some performance evaluations that I could turn in to Dr. Alcobar for credit. Thank you for your consideration, and if you would like to see my transcript, I would be happy to forward it to you.

All the best,
Carl Ennens
To: Carl Ennens <cennens@gmail.com>
From: John Masterson <jmasterson@mastersttrokeindustries..com>
Date: December 31
Subject: Internship

Dear Carl Ennens,

Iappreciate your interest in interning with us here at Master Stroke Industries. We have not accepted a lot of interns in the past, but I know Dr. Alcobar personally, and if he recommended that you contact us, he must have faith in your ability. I think we should set up an interview at our headquarters downtown on Holly Street. We can get to know each other a bit over some coffee and 1I will show you around our facilities. Don't worry about your transcripts; like I said, if Dr. Alcobar thinks you''ll be a good fit, I'll trust his judgment. How about this coming Friday at 10 A.M.?

Look forward to meeting you Carl,
John Masterson
CEO, Master Stroke Industries
Memorandum To Master Stroke Industry Employees

This spring, at Master Stroke Industries, we will have an intern assisting us with everything from making coffee to solving complex equations. Carl Ennens Is a student here at the University and has kindly offered his services in exchange for a piece of our operational knowledge. Please treat him with respect and don't be afraid to use him for an extra pair of hands, eyes, or opinion should you need it. And I did hear he makes a good cup of coffee!

Brand-X Coming town

March 9 - Popular Danish skincare company Brand--Xis finally launching their best-selling line in America. The 88-year-old company has been Denmark's leading skincare brand and the top selling cream, Xtreme 7, has been Europe's most popular facial cream for over 10 years. Though Americans may not have had access to these creams before, the brand is already generating much excitement. D erm atologist Dr. Francis Keenan explains, "Tests have shown that Xtreme 7 dramatically reduces the fine lines around the eye area and laugh lines after only 30 days of use, but the price of the cream is only a fraction of what department store brands sell for. I'll definitely recommend this cream to my clients."

"People have been asking about Xtreme 7 but the products haven't even arrived yet!" added Susan Chan, an employee at a beauty counter. "People are already calling in to pre- order."

A spokesperson for the company explained that Brand-X is making moves to expand into the North American and Asian markets. For now, only the best-selling line will be available sometime next month, outside of Europe, but within a year, more products will be available.
Brand-X Positions at American Headquarters in Westminster, California

Don't miss your chance to work In an exciting career in skincare and beauty with Brand-X. 80 administrative and customer service positions will be available regardless of experience. Applicants need to have good communication skills, bilingual ability in both English and Spanish is preferred but not necessary, and knowledge in computer use is a must. Applicants with experience in cosmetics, dermatology, or marketing will get a chance to work in several management positions for Brand-X. Please visit our website at www.brandx.com/jobs for more information. Ydu can fill out the application forms and send them in before March 20th. Interviews will take place at Hillway Building on 143 Garden Road. Be sure to bring your resumes and reference letters.
To: Professor David Mills
From: Jacqueline O'Hare
Date: March 28
Subject: Job

Dear Professor Mills,

Thank you so much for the reference letter you supplied me with. 1I was recenttlly hired by Brand-X and I begin my orientations next week Wednesday at 10:00 A.M. However, we have our statistics test at that time. Is there any way that I can take a make-up test a~t a different time or hand in another assignment as a replacement for the test? I would hate to miss the orientations which are mandatory and I don't want · to disappoint my new employers. The job should not have any other impact on my school work otherwise. 1I kindly appreciate your consideration in this.

Sincerely,
Jacquelline O'Hare
